description: Dismisses a Sergio suggestion card, as the card's dismiss does. reason is optional ("Not needed" tells the Scanner that raised it that it was wrong). Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat returns the first answer.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: dismiss_suggestion
title: Dismiss a Sergio suggestion
